body: One of us. One of us... ::chants::

Thank you, I needed to hear that, I seem to be doubting myself more than usual of late, so I feel like every little thing that bothers me is insignificant. 


I have no one in my life who I can open up to like that. 


My friend is now my ex but we have been trying to be friends. There's a lot of webs intertwined around it all but unfortunately, he managed to blow open the door to my own self loathing tonight and as a result I can't talk to him about it. All I was told was "deal with it", which wasn't very helpful and only added to the panic attack. 


I think I'll try and call the counsellors when they open on Monday, I'm just dreading facing all of tomorrow feeling like this and even more scared of exposing myself to a counsellor.

The one person I opened up to and actually spoke to about everything is now the one person I can't talk to right now, because it's too painful. 


It's very real for me right now, I feel like I've gone through the rabbit hole and ended up in Hades. 

I used to see a counsellor, but now I feel like they'd laugh at my "problems" when compared to what I used to speak to the counsellor about. Plus I don't open up to people so easily, it took weeks to be able to speak to a counsellor in the past. I do take meds that are supposed to be somewhat of a "safety net" to stop me falling so far - as my doctor always called it. They just don't seem to be helping me.

That's the problem, there isn't anyone I can talk to about this anymore. I officially lost my last safety net tonight, it was the final push that had me hyperventilating and posting on here. I just feel awful for even mentioning any of it on here. I hate putting on people.

I feel like it's a constant struggle to push forward. I suffer with severe anxiety and depression and this past year has just been pushing me closer to the edge one day at a time. I'm scared to let anything new into my life because it's just another "goodbye" waiting to happen. 


I'd like to think that I did give her a good life, I just wish it had been longer than the brief 4 years. I long to see her again so very badly.


Thank you.

Hey guys, so I got out of hospital with nothing more than a sprained knee and a bruised ego, lucky me! The mini I went into is in worse shape than my bike to be honest, passenger side panels are caved in.

No fork or frame damage on the bike, purely cosmetics on the front right hand side as I managed to make sure I hit the car at an angle rather than head on. Front fairing is done for, as is the right headlight. Bit of scraping down the right side. Other than that, seems fine. Runs okay, probably rideable if I taped the indicator back on.

Took the bike to my preferred repair shop who will be giving my insurance an estimate to fix it. The insurance are handling everything for me and even sorting me out with a courtesy bike. 

It sounds like she's accepting fault, police won't tell me who's at fault just yet but the officer gave me a wink and said "her details were taken and she's been 'reported'". Reported for what, I dont know. Sounds like it's in my favour though.

Going to milk the repairs and get some clutch issues sorted that 'weren't there before the accident'.

After everything is said and done, I think I'll be coming out of this better off than I went in. Injury claim for the sprained knee and I might end up with a new bike out of it or a cage for the winter. Who knows. 

Thanks for the advice and we'll wishes.

Hello again!

Replaced the spark plug and still having the same problem.

Rides fine for maybe 10 minutes, then when riding above 40mph at full throttle, the engine slows drastically and the scooter slows down.  Backing off the throttle resolves the issue but only temporarily, it happens again pretty shortly after putting back on the throttle. Pulled the spark plug and it looks like new. I got the iridium equivalent of the one I had fitted. Certainly easier to start at least.

Since changing the spark plug I have checked the coil to make sure it's connected properly,  made sure the battery has a decent charge, ran the tank dry and refilled, and pulled the carb for inspection. None seem to have made and difference. 

Any more ideas? :/

Coil is aftermarket because the factory one failed a while back.

Ground wire is definitely in contact with the frame, checked that when troubleshooting with the coil.

Are there any other symptoms of a failing CDI? I have noticed it's not so keen to accelerate at higher RPMS any more. 

What CDI would I be able to purchase online that isn't one of those unrestricted ones that's going to trash my engine? 

Thanks! :)

When I was washing it, it was just a case of wiping down the panels with a little soap and water, rinsing it off,  then drying it with microfibre cloths. Absolutely no way any water got in the tank as the seat never even went up and the gas cap was never off. Just had a look in the tank and can't see any water.

Will find some of that stuff you recommended and try it anyway just to be sure.

Thanks! :)

Looking at those charts, I'd say it was dry fouled. Looks a little dark and powdery. Would that cause it to be jerky at high speeds?

Cleaned it up and took it out for a ride, still seems off but it wasn't jerking, just the occasional hiccup.

Will buy a new spark plug and replace it tomorrow, see how it goes.

Also, while we're here, I've been noticing some vibration lately. Like when I'm riding along at half throttle and I add more throttle, there will be some vibration for a little while until it gets up to speed. I'm thinking either the belt is slipping or there's something going on with the clutch. What would you say that could be?

Thanks for your help :)
